segments.name: Used Cars
segments.description: Sells used cars online to U.S. consumers, with delivery, pickup, financing and complementary protection products.
segments.evidence: We collectively refer to VSC, GAP, and auto insurance as complementary products.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for used vehicles, in-house financing, and complementary products including vehicle service contracts, GAP and auto insurance.
revenueModel.evidence: For customers who choose not to utilize our financing, we also accept payment in cash or financing from third party lenders, such as banks or credit unions.
